severity: P2
file: desk/bin/pass.mjs:1231
title: readPrStatus restates gate.mjs normaliseRollup inline instead of reusing it
detail: The new mapping `(v.statusCheckRollup ?? []).filter((c) => c && (c.name || c.context)).map((c) => ({ ...normaliseCheck(c), workflow: c.workflowName ?? null, startedAt: c.startedAt ?? null, ... }))` is the same as the exported `normaliseRollup` in gate.mjs, plus one extra field, `completedAt`. If the shared helper later changes how it filters or names fields, this copy will not get the change. That matters most for latestPerCheck, which uses the `workflow` and `startedAt` keys to pick the latest run of each check.
evidence: desk/bin/pass.mjs:1231-1233; desk/bin/gate.mjs:61-63 (normaliseRollup), gate.mjs:73-85 (latestPerCheck keys on workflow/startedAt)
suggested_fix: Add `completedAt: n.completedAt ?? null` to normaliseRollup in gate.mjs (other callers ignore extra fields). Then call `latestPerCheck(normaliseRollup(v.statusCheckRollup))` in pass.mjs and import normaliseRollup in place of normaliseCheck.

FINDING
severity: P2
file: desk/bin/desk-q.mjs:793
title: FAILED_CHECK is a copy of gate.mjs's FAILED conclusion set
detail: desk-q's new `FAILED_CHECK` set repeats gate.mjs's `FAILED` set entry for entry. The merge gate decides whether a check failed from gate.mjs's set, and desk-q decides whether to show "<check> failed" (red) from its own copy. If a conclusion is added to one set and not the other, desk-q will show "all checks passed · merging" for a PR the gate holds as failed, or the other way round.
evidence: desk/bin/desk-q.mjs:793-795; desk/bin/gate.mjs:36 (not exported)
suggested_fix: Export FAILED from gate.mjs, or a small `checkFailed(c)` predicate, and import it in desk-q.mjs in place of the local set.

FINDING
severity: P2
file: desk/bin/desk-q.mjs:164
title: Redefining r.done drops landing tickets from the overview's DONE column and counts closed or no-PR tickets as merged
detail: `r.done` used to count every done ticket. It now subtracts the landing ones. The overview still prints r.done under the DONE heading, and it has no landing column, so a done ticket whose PR is open is now counted in no overview column at all. The other direction is also wrong. The workers line labels r.done as "merged, not shown", but r.done also includes done tickets whose PR was recorded CLOSED, done tickets with no PR, and done tickets whose PR no pass has read yet. Only OPEN is taken out (`landing` is `state === 'OPEN'`). So a ticket whose PR was closed unmerged is hidden and called merged.
evidence: desk/bin/desk-q.mjs:163-164 (r.landing, r.done); desk/bin/desk-q.mjs:92 (landing = OPEN only); desk/bin/desk-q.mjs:720 and :731 (overview DONE column prints r.done); desk/bin/desk-q.mjs:909 ("merged, not shown")
suggested_fix: Count "merged" only from done tickets whose pr_status state is MERGED, and show closed and unread ones separately or as "done". In the overview, either keep DONE as all done tickets (r.done + r.landing.length) or add a landing count, so the columns still add up to the queue.
